matrix_convention: Unchanged object-to-world animation matrices; downstream left-multiplies per-frame world-to-clip camera_matrices.npy.
limitations: Rigid/affine-piece adaptation; not an exact recovered rig or pixel-for-pixel match.
Torso and upper/lower arms are reconstructed source-constrained surfaces to separate the fused hands/belly; hidden contact anatomy is an authored approximation.
Head, eye, hand, leg and foot surfaces are retained from the source LOD with local cutting and joint closure.
Mouth cavity, lips, teeth, tongue, eyelid skin and neck connector are newly constructed animation geometry in the working copy.
Source material sampled into per-corner sRGB colors; reconstructed regions use source-derived color interpolation; original .blend unchanged.
The B simplification RMS does not measure the additional animation retopology error.

adaptation_measurements.torso: 30 horizontal cross sections and 40 angles; positive original-surface ray distance is a hard bound; front/back central diameters and unobstructed back-half width constrain a smooth ellipse beneath fused arms/hands.
adaptation_measurements.arms: 7 transverse rings with 12 angles per segment; original-surface ray samples, radius limits and second-harmonic smoothing; measured exposed upper-arm radii approximately 0.069 to 0.084 source units.
adaptation_measurements.hands: Original triangles clipped internally at min(170-R,130-G)>=0 in sampled source color; boundary closures retain dark fingers without carrying unrelated belly corners.
adaptation_measurements.pose: Reference timing and fixed-scale projected bbox-center offsets are measurements; 3D joint angles and hidden motion remain authored estimates.
adaptation_measurements.camera: assets/naiwa/camera.json; fixed camera and fixed scale for all 541 frames; only root translation is fitted to the reference center trajectory.
adaptation_measurements.fall: Selected visible-feet pose parameters are stored in fall_pose_constraints.json; corrections blend over frames 406..417; hand targets interpolate measured reference landmarks and contact the transformed torso front surface.
adaptation_measurements.landing_deformation: World-Z compression blends from 1.0 to 0.8 over frames 412..417 and remains 0.8 afterward. This is an empirical nonrigid cartoon-pose fit, not measured physical depth or a recovered source rig. It is applied before final hand contact IK and does not alter the fixed camera or source file.
adaptation_measurements.blender_affine: Each GPU group is represented by a two-object SVD transform hierarchy to preserve shear at all 541 integer frames. GPU storage remains one full 4x4 affine transform per triangle group.
adaptation_measurements.mouth: Asymmetric smile cavity, three-dimensional curved tooth rows, and 541-frame observed mouth-mask constraints. Occluded frames 411..415 are excluded from expression fitting rather than forced visible.
adaptation_measurements.eyes: Original source eye surfaces retained; closed-eye arc geometry and eye_closure_curve.json follow inspected reference intervals, including the closed eyes at frame 186.
adaptation_measurements.neck: Seven source-surface ray-sampled neck cross sections with 24 angular samples form the continuous affine neck sleeve.
adaptation_measurements.ankles: Source triangles are clipped at local Z=-0.430, retaining interpolated source colors and closed ankle cut surfaces. Groups 16/17 articulate feet independently from calf groups 7/9. Both sides use measured cut-ring centers as the shared calf/foot joint.
adaptation_measurements.motion_refinement: motion_refinement.json separates planted crouch, upright jump, backward fall, head self-occlusion and arm/leg contact targets. Single-view depth and joint rotations remain authored fits.

geometry_adaptation.method: Closed three-dimensional posterior oral shell attached to the existing outer lip contour, in mouth group 13. Original front cavity, teeth, source surfaces, group count and all pose matrices are unchanged.
geometry_adaptation.exterior_color: Existing lip color at its seam; inverse-distance samples of source-derived head/jaw/neck skin colors on the posterior shell.
geometry_adaptation.limitations: A V2 authored closure for side and rear viewing, not newly recovered source anatomy. Requires no-Z whole-orbit validation after cache construction.

camera_motion: One 360 degree world-Z orbit over the full original 541-frame laugh animation.
